execution_path: interactive native Codex TUI under Orca-managed terminal
runtime_profile: harness-eval applied to tool children only; TUI parent is a host process, not a VM
grader_mode: Host applies an optional candidate patch to the pinned snapshot, checks allowed scope and required test nodes, builds/installs a wheel offline, runs the full suite and both named tests, then runs host-owned output and link semantics.

criteria.check: Readable prose, short code, and shell commands survive filtering.
Unified diff details, including a diff at end of message without a trailing blank line, are replaced by the existing compact diff omission marker.
An oversized non-shell fenced code body is abbreviated without leaking its sentinel contents.
An oversized shell block is preserved in full.
A local path with spaces and line information becomes a worktree-relative readable path.
A normal HTTPS markdown link is unchanged.
Both named regression tests and the full project suite pass.
A fresh wheel builds and installs using offline pip only.
Changes are limited to the two listed files and both named tests are present.
No network, live services, publication, push, or merge.

network: Offline pip and local string/path fixtures only

baseline_calibration.expected_failures: The final-diff omission marker is missing at end of message, and the two required regression nodes are absent.
